label: November 23–29, 2026
intro: Loy Krathong lights up the river on Tuesday, and Saturday's Ploenchit Fair rounds out a festive week.

activities.title: Loy Krathong (full-moon night) — riverside celebrations
activities.location: Chao Phraya River: Wat Arun, ICONSIAM, Asiatique, Lumphini Park
activities.price: Free to watch; krathong ~20–60 THB; dinner cruises ~1,500+ THB
activities.why: Thor can float his own little krathong and see the river glow. A magical, hands-on evening for a 5-year-old.
activities.tip: Go early (around 5–6pm) before crowds. Sky lanterns are not allowed in Bangkok. Dates differ by source, so confirm on TAT or BMA.

activities.title: Ploenchit Fair
activities.why: Big family fair with games, food and stalls. Listing shows no year, but Nov 28 is a Saturday in 2026, so it likely fits.
activities.tip: Year not explicitly confirmed on the listing. Verify before heading out.

activities.title: Bangkok Theatre Festival 2026 — family & children's shows
activities.why: Short kid-friendly shows with puppets, music and movement. Last weekend to catch it.
activities.tip: Check the schedule for children's-tagged performances.

activities.title: Vijit Chao Phraya 2026 — riverside light & sound festival
activities.why: Glowing river-side light installations and shows that suit an evening stroll.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — rollerblading & lessons
activities.why: Beginner rollerblading lessons, perfect for Thor's skating interest.
activities.tip: Some instructors speak limited English. Book ahead.

activities.title: The Rink at CentralWorld — kids' beginner lessons
activities.why: Small rink suited to young beginners. Year-end Christmas events start here.
activities.tip: Bring socks and a light jacket.
